meta.title: The Hidden Reason Airport Runways Are Changing Their Numbers #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever noticed the giant numbers painted on airport runways? They aren't random. Those numbers actually represent compass bearings, rounded to the nearest ten degrees. So a runway pointing east at ninety degrees gets painted with a giant zero nine. But here is the bizarre truth. Earth's magnetic north pole is moving, drifting up to thirty-four miles every single year. Because our magnetic field is constantly shifting, compass headings for runways slowly drift out of alignment. Major airports worldwide are forced to quietly shut down, repaint their tarmac, and update global navigation systems just to fix one digit. Pilots landing blind in fog rely on these exact numbers to prevent fatal mistakes. Did you know Earth's poles moved this fast? Comment below and follow for more!
